hero.title: High-altitude cocoa from Bahia, now in Aveiro.
hero.lead: At Fazenda Eustáquio the trees grow in the shade of the Atlantic Forest, with no agrochemicals. A family house since the nineteenth century — with about one tonne of beans ready for chefs, makers and distributors in Europe.

A ring of selected cocoa beans

bahia.title: Fazenda Eustáquio, southern Bahia
bahia.text: Near Jussari and the Serra do Teimoso reserve, around 1000 m above sea level. Shade-grown cocoa in the Atlantic Forest.
bahia.alt: Cocoa on the tree at Fazenda Eustáquio

aveiro.title: Stock in Aveiro, Portugal
aveiro.text: About 1 tonne of beans for Europe. No shopping cart: write for a lot or a sample.
aveiro.alt: A box of rustic Amêndoa D'Cacau chocolate held in the hand

family.title: In cocoa since the nineteenth century
family.text: Our great-great-grandfather was already working the fruit in Brazil in 1890 — that is what the packaging still says, since 1890. Later generations stayed on the land. For more than fifteen years our father has run Fazenda Eustáquio, from tree to bar.

teasers.title: Beans for Europe
teasers.text: Lots from 1 kg. The focus for chefs, makers and distributors in the EU.

teasers.alt: Amêndoa D'Cacau mark, integral natural, since 1890
teasers.title: Our story
teasers.text: A Brazilian rustic-chocolate house, with a European base in Aveiro.

teasers.alt: Cocoa drying barge at Fazenda Eustáquio
teasers.title: The farm
teasers.text: Shade of jequitibá and ipê trees. Grown ecologically, without agrochemicals.

ctaBand.title: Want to work with this cocoa?
ctaBand.text: A quote, a sample, or a lot sitting in Aveiro — write to us. We answer as a house, not as a shop.
